About This Dashboard:


This is a point in time view and is meant to represent the current position, rather than a trend. The charts should be used to identify projects which are not running to plan, where executive oversight/review is required, or where a process to remedy should be instigated.


Variance Against Budget

For all projects where there is effort remaining, the chart shows the projected margin at completion versus the original planned/budgeted margin. The underlying report provides navigation to the Engagement Dashboard to show the detailed situation for each project.


RAG Summary Status

For all firm projects where there is effort remaining, the table shows the latest engagement status.


Non-Billable Time

The chart shows any project where time has been recorded that will not be charged to the customer. This non-billable time is planned to impact cost only. Any work that is not being charged to the customer is an indicator of poor project health and therefore should be highlighted at an executive level.


Revenue Write-Offs

The information provided in the chart and underlying report shows where additional unplanned free-of-charge effort is being expended in order to deliver the project. This may be an indicator that there is a commercial or delivery risk, or original planning was poor, and also that customer satisfaction could be at risk.
